Application Data.NAME: Jones Department Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Jones Department Store operates as a retail establishment specializing in a diverse range of discounted merchandise, including household goods, clothing, electronics, and seasonal items. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction, we provide quality products at competitive prices to our local community. The store maintains a physical storefront with a moderate online presence, accounting for less than 25% of our total revenue. We prioritize effective inventory management and have implemented robust loss prevention measures to mitigate risks associated with theft and product damage. Our operations are designed to ensure a safe shopping environment for customers and employees alike.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2022, Jones Department Store experienced a loss due to a burst water pipe in the electronics section, causing water damage to merchandise and fixtures. The estimated damage amounted to $10,000, which is currently under review for repair and restoration. All relevant claims have been submitted and are pending approval. Additionally, on July 15, 2021, minor theft incidents were reported, resulting in losses totaling $5,000. These thefts have prompted an increase in security measures, and the status of the resolution for these incidents is complete. Total Losses reported: $15,000.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1, UL Listed Safe
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols and a monitored alarm system are in place, supplemented by 85% sprinkler coverage and regular safety audits to enhance loss prevention measures.
